name: Right the Vote
summary:
Everyone deserves to have their voices heard. But there have been more than 400 anti-voter bills introduced in 48 states that have unfairly impacted a wide range of communities resulting in a fractured democracy that doesn’t fully represent the desires of the people.

Inspired by online stories collected from #wevotewecount of first-hand experiences of voter suppression, we aim to create an educational narrative that highlights both deliberate and less noticeable strategies that local governments employ to
